Lead PM — SMB Lending Platform, EMEA remote.

Brickline (80 people, Series B) provides revenue-based financing to small online businesses through an embedded checkout partner network. We're hiring a Lead PM to own the borrower application flow, underwriting data integrations and repayment experience. You'll lead one PM and work with credit-risk analysts. Fully remote within Europe. Consumer-credit or BNPL experience transfers well — we care about underwriting instincts and funnel work, not prior B2B lending.
